message.content:

Alison has already initiated the process. She has checked the calendars of Priya Raman and Marcus Hale and has provided a list of 30-minute slots when they are both available. My next step is to check the calendars of Elena Soto and David Okafor to see which of these proposed slots work for them.

The slots proposed by Alison are:
*   Mon, Nov 16: 09:00, 09:30
*   Tue, Nov 17: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
*   Wed, Nov 18: 15:00, 15:30
*   Thu, Nov 19: 10:00
*   Fri, Nov 20: 11:00, 11:30

I will use my first two actions to read the calendars of Elena Soto and David Okafor. Then, I will compare their availability with the list provided by Alison. Finally, I will communicate my findings to Alison via the shared workspace.
